hello.text: Oh! Somebody new. Come here, I'll show you some footwork.

intro.text: I'm meant to be sweeping. Want to learn some footwork instead?

intro_more.text: Nothing in here is safe. That's the fun of it.

kit_nag.text: Your kit's still lying where you fell, you know. Same floor, same room.

no_raids.text: You haven't even been down yet? The gate's in the hideout.

bye_for_now.text: That's all I've got. Go and break something.

teach_double.text: Jump, then jump again while you're still in the air.

teach_wall.text: Now a wall. Jump at one, and jump again as you touch it.

teach_dash.text: Last one: dash. Sideways only, mind. Never up.

lessons_done.text: That's everything I know. The Tinker knows the rest.

knew_it_all.text: You know all this already, don't you? Never mind me, then.

nice_double.text: There you go! The air holds you once.

nice_wall.text: Ha! Walls are only floors standing up.

nice_dash.text: Quick! Too quick to hit, for a moment.

winded.text: Out of breath? Four dashes to a full bar. Watch it under your health.

parried.text: A parry! Where did you learn that?
